d:
Bihar ke purv up mukhyamantri aur neta pratipaksh tejasvi yadav ne rajy men lagatar bigarti kanun-vyavastha aur barhte apradh ke graph ko lekar rajy sarkar aur pulis prashasan par karara hamla bola hai.
Tejasvi yadav ne midiya se batchit karte hue kaha ki bihar men aaj jaisi sthiti ban chuki hai, vaisi dardanak aur khauphnak ghatnaen aaj tak dekhne ko nahin mili hain. unhonne aarop lagaya ki pure rajy men apradhiyon ka bolbala ho chuka hai aur koee aisa din nahin bitta jab rajy men mardar, rep aur lut jaisi sangin vardaten na ho rahi hon.
